filters: ENTRY_DATETIME >= (SELECT MAX(ENTRY_DATETIME) - 50 * INTERVAL '1' DAY FROM ATS.TRADES)
assumptions: The query implies a client who has executed trades in the last 50 trades, and we are to identify the client who started accumulating a single symbol in those trades.
The term 'accumulation' is interpreted as a client who has executed multiple trades of the same symbol in the last 50 trades.
The query does not specify a date range, so no date filtering is applied beyond the last 50 trades.
The client's name is to be returned along with the symbol and trade count, as per the 'complete info' request.
